# Astro Fanblog

> Open-source blog software for football fan communities — news, match
> reports, squad, loans, schedule and community features, built with Astro
> and Supabase. Independent and fan-run — no club colours, written by fans.

## Pages

- [Home](https://example.com/): Overview of the latest articles.
- [All articles](https://example.com/beitraege): Archive of all articles.
- [Squad](https://example.com/kader): The current squad of your club.
- [Loans](https://example.com/leihspieler): Loaned players with stats.
- [Schedule](https://example.com/spielplan): Match history as a timeline.
- [RSS feed](https://example.com/rss.xml): New articles via RSS.
- [Sitemap](https://example.com/sitemap.xml): All indexable pages.

## Crawler policies

- robots.txt: https://example.com/robots.txt
- AI crawlers are welcome (Content-Signal: ai=allow); using the content for training is not permitted (ai-input=disallow).
- API catalog for agents: https://example.com/.well-known/api-catalog
- Articles support content negotiation: `Accept: text/markdown` returns the article as Markdown.
